name: Official MCP Registry
measures: Servers published to the registry, by first publish month
about: This data comes from the Official MCP Registry, a public list of MCP servers. We count each server name once, in the month it was first published, and do not store its metadata.
attribution: This data comes from the Official MCP Registry, dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0. We are not affiliated with or endorsed by the registry.
limitations: Publishing is optional, so growth also reflects people adopting the registry.
The registry launched in September 2025 and is in preview, so its data could be reset.
Older servers appear when they were first published here, not when they were built.
